fusions.name: Crack the Shell
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A cracking blow that deals 22 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dinner Gong
fusions.desc: Sounds a gong, dealing 12 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Stockpot Helm
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Laid-Down Reserves
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once into a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
